name: Rolls-Royce Data Synthesizer
subtitle: Synthetic turbofan sensor data, validated against NASA C-MAPSS FD001
description: An interactive dashboard that walks through the full pipeline: import real run-to-failure engine data, train a model, fine-tune it with LoRA, generate synthetic data, and validate it. The fine-tuned diffusion model passes the KS test on 3 of 3 sensors (91% similarity) against real FD001 data. Every run in the demo replays a real recorded training run.
items: Refactored a transformer ML pipeline, externalizing 15+ hyperparameters into YAML configs with 6 CLI flags for single command reproducible execution
Built an auto-checkpointing system persisting model weights, optimizer state, and scheduler every 5 epochs, enabling seamless training resumption after interruptions
Designed a Streamlit frontend with a custom CSS design system wiring 3 backend ML modules to UI controls, supporting reactive data manipulation across interactive visualizations
